name: Eighteen ~Bishoujo Chikan Yuugi~
source:
Three years after the bus molester incident, the main character returns to the scene. He rents a bus and starts to dictate his conditions when pretty girls board it.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-september-2004-abandoner.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
公交车痴汉事件过去三年后，主人公重新回到事发地点。他租下一辆公交车，并在漂亮少女上车时开始向她们提出自己的条件。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-september-2004-abandoner.html]vndbreview[/url]]
